articles.summary: Meet Dibs the Muad'dib, SpiceDB's new mascot that embodies our commitment to resilience, adaptability, and precision in solving complex authorization challenges. Drawing inspiration from Frank Herbert's Dune universe, this vigilant desert creature symbolizes how SpiceDB navigates the harsh terrain of modern access control with efficiency and intelligence.
articles.title: Meet Dibs: The Mascot Bringing SpiceDB to Life
